text: That camera was bolted to that wall for eleven years. You have undone it in a second. I hope you are proud of yourself.
Please stop opening portals behind the cameras. They are not insured. Neither, I should point out, are you.
A camera has fallen off the wall. I will log it as a bird strike. There are no birds. It will be a very short log.
Cameras are expensive. Portals are free. I leave you to work out which of us is losing money.
That is every camera in this room, lying on the floor. I cannot see you now. I can still hear you being smug.
Every camera in the facility is on a floor somewhere. I have made you an award out of the staff budget. It is a certificate. It says Blind Spot. It is also an apology I will deny.
